speaker_title: Address by Mr. Shavkat Mirziyoyev, President of the Republic of Uzbekistan

paragraphs.text: DISTINGUISHED PRESIDENT VOLKAN BOZKIR!
paragraphs.raw_text: DISTINGUISHED PRESIDENT VOLKAN BOZKIR!

paragraphs.text: DISTINGUISHED SECRETARY-GENERAL ANTONIO GUTERRES! DISTINGUISHED HEADS OF DELEGATIONS!
paragraphs.raw_text:
DISTINGUISHED 
SECRETARY-GENERAL 
ANTONIO 
GUTERRES! 
DISTINGUISHED HEADS OF DELEGATIONS!

paragraphs.text: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!
paragraphs.raw_text: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!

paragraphs.text: The seventy-fifth session of the General Assembly is being held for the first time in the history of the United Nations in a completely new format — an online videoconferencing due to the coronavirus pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The seventy-fifth session of the General Assembly is being held for the first 
time in the history of the United Nations in a completely new format — an online 
videoconferencing due to the coronavirus pandemic.

paragraphs.text: Such a global catastrophe has not been observed on our planet in the last hundred years.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Such a global catastrophe has not been observed on our planet in the last 
hundred years.

paragraphs.text: This calamity has vividly revealed humanity’s vulnerability.
paragraphs.raw_text: This calamity has vividly revealed humanity’s vulnerability.

paragraphs.text: The current threatening and complex situation has proved that all states and peoples of the world are interconnected and that regular dialogue, trust and close cooperation among us are extremely important.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The current threatening and complex situation has proved that all states and 
peoples of the world are interconnected and that regular dialogue, trust and close 
cooperation among us are extremely important.

paragraphs.text: In this context, all of us have deeply realized the need to consolidating the mutual efforts of governments, parliaments, civil society institutions; strengthening the principles of common responsibility; coordinating international partnership accordingly; increasing the status and capacity, as well as expanding the competences of the World Health Organization.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this context, all of us have deeply realized the need to consolidating the 
mutual efforts of governments, parliaments, civil society institutions; strengthening 
the principles of common responsibility; coordinating international partnership 
accordingly; increasing the status and capacity, as well as expanding the competences 
of the World Health Organization.

paragraphs.text: Our goal is to jointly create fair global system that ensures basic rights, freedoms, health and well-being of every human being.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Our goal is to jointly create fair global system that ensures basic rights, 
freedoms, health and well-being of every human being.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, we propose to develop under the UN auspices an International Code of Voluntary Commitments of States during pandemics.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, we propose to develop under the UN auspices an International 
Code of Voluntary Commitments of States during pandemics.

paragraphs.text: This document should reflect each state’s commitments to its citizens and international partners.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This document should reflect each state’s commitments to its citizens and 
international partners.

paragraphs.text: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!
paragraphs.raw_text: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!

paragraphs.text: Since the early days of the COVID-19 outbreak in Uzbekistan, we have focused all our efforts and resources to containing this dangerous disease and, most importantly, saving the people’s lives.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Since the early days of the COVID-19 outbreak in Uzbekistan, we have 
focused all our efforts and resources to containing this dangerous disease and, most 
importantly, saving the people’s lives.

paragraphs.text: Social protection and health systems are being cardinally strengthened to mitigate the negative effects of the pandemic; targeted support is provided to the population, sectors of the economy and businesses.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Social protection and health systems are being cardinally strengthened to 
mitigate the negative effects of the pandemic; targeted support is provided to the 
population, sectors of the economy and businesses.

paragraphs.text: Special funds have been set up to this end.
paragraphs.raw_text: Special funds have been set up to this end.

paragraphs.text: I would like to take this opportunity to express my deep gratitude to all our friends and partners who have generously supported during this time of trials.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to take this opportunity to express my deep gratitude to all our 
friends and partners who have generously supported during this time of trials.

paragraphs.text: We fully support the international community’s all efforts to effectively combat the pandemic, including the development and widespread use of essential drugs and vaccines.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We fully support the international community’s all efforts to effectively 
combat the pandemic, including the development and widespread use of essential 
drugs and vaccines.

paragraphs.text: We also welcome the proposal of Secretary-General Antonio Guterres to hold a summit on the pressing issues of food security in the current context of the crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We also welcome the proposal of Secretary-General Antonio Guterres to hold 
a summit on the pressing issues of food security in the current context of the crisis.

paragraphs.text: DEAR PARTICIPANTS OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY!
paragraphs.raw_text: DEAR PARTICIPANTS OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY!

paragraphs.text: Three years ago, speaking from the high rostrum of the United Nations, I stated that Uzbekistan was firmly determined to implement radical reforms.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Three years ago, speaking from the high rostrum of the United Nations, I 
stated that Uzbekistan was firmly determined to implement radical reforms.

paragraphs.text: As a result of our large-scale measures on political, social and economic modernization of society, a new Uzbekistan is being formed.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a result of our large-scale measures on political, social and economic 
modernization of society, a new Uzbekistan is being formed.

paragraphs.text: Today, the process of democratic transformations in our country has become irreversible.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Today, the process of democratic transformations in our country has 
become irreversible.

paragraphs.text: Last year’s parliamentary elections demonstrated the growing political activism of the population and parties, the role of civil society institutions and the influence of the media.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Last year’s parliamentary elections demonstrated the growing political 
activism of the population and parties, the role of civil society institutions and the 
influence of the media.

paragraphs.text: The gender equality policy became a priority for us.
paragraphs.raw_text: The gender equality policy became a priority for us.

paragraphs.text: The role of women in public administration is growing. In our new Parliament the number of women deputies has doubled.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The role of women in public administration is growing. In our new Parliament 
the number of women deputies has doubled.

paragraphs.text: The human rights situation has also completely changed. The forced and child labour were fully abolished. The National Human Rights Strategy was adopted.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The human rights situation has also completely changed. The forced and child 
labour were fully abolished. The National Human Rights Strategy was adopted.

paragraphs.text: In response to a call from the United Nations to reduce the number of stateless persons, this year alone 50,000 of our compatriots were granted Uzbek citizenship.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In response to a call from the United Nations to reduce the number of stateless 
persons, this year alone 50,000 of our compatriots were granted Uzbek citizenship.

paragraphs.text: The situation with religious freedom in our country has also improved dramatically.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The 
situation 
with 
religious 
freedom 
in 
our 
country 
has 
also 
improved dramatically.

paragraphs.text: Further strengthening the inter-ethnic harmony and inter-religious tolerance is a constant important task for us.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Further strengthening the inter-ethnic harmony and inter-religious tolerance is 
a constant important task for us.

paragraphs.text: Comprehensive reforms to ensure true independence of the judiciary and the rule of law are being consistently implemented.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Comprehensive reforms to ensure true independence of the judiciary and the 
rule of law are being consistently implemented.

paragraphs.text: The uncompromising fight against corruption has reached a new level.
paragraphs.raw_text: The uncompromising fight against corruption has reached a new level.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, important legislation has been adopted and independent Anti-Corruption Agency was established.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, important legislation has been adopted and independent 
Anti-Corruption Agency was established.

paragraphs.text: The economic reforms are being dynamically continued in our country.
paragraphs.raw_text: The economic reforms are being dynamically continued in our country.

paragraphs.text: For the first time, we have publicly declared our determination to reduce poverty.
paragraphs.raw_text: For the first time, we have publicly declared our determination to reduce poverty.

paragraphs.text: We are achieving this through development of entrepreneurship and job creation; improving the investment climate and business environment; building a modern infrastructure and providing targeted social assistance to the population through training people to new professions.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are achieving this through development of entrepreneurship and job 
creation; improving the investment climate and business environment; building a 
modern infrastructure and providing targeted social assistance to the population 
through training people to new professions.

paragraphs.text: In our country, where over half of the population is young, an extensive work is underway to ensure that every young person takes a worthy place in society and demonstrate their potential.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In our country, where over half of the population is young, an extensive work 
is underway to ensure that every young person takes a worthy place in society and 
demonstrate their potential.

paragraphs.text: The Youth Parliaments and the Agency for Youth Affairs are operating in Uzbekistan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Youth Parliaments and the Agency for Youth Affairs are operating 
in Uzbekistan.

paragraphs.text: In August the Samarkand International Forum on Youth Rights was successfully held under the auspices of the United Nations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In August the Samarkand International Forum on Youth Rights was successfully 
held under the auspices of the United Nations.

paragraphs.text: I would like to take this opportunity to once again call on you to support Uzbekistan’s initiative to adopt the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Youth.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to take this opportunity to once again call on you to support 
Uzbekistan’s initiative to adopt the United Nations Convention on the Rights of 
the Youth.

paragraphs.text: In addition, we propose to adopt a special resolution of the United Nations General Assembly on enhancing the role of parliaments in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and ensuring human rights.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In addition, we propose to adopt a special resolution of the United Nations 
General Assembly on enhancing the role of parliaments in achieving the Sustainable 
Development Goals and ensuring human rights.

paragraphs.text: DEAR FRIENDS!
paragraphs.raw_text: DEAR FRIENDS!

paragraphs.text: The fundamental changes are taking place now in the region of Central Asia.
paragraphs.raw_text: The fundamental changes are taking place now in the region of Central Asia.

paragraphs.text: We have managed to create an atmosphere of good neighbourliness, mutual trust, friendship and mutual respect among the states of the region.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have managed to create an atmosphere of good neighbourliness, mutual 
trust, friendship and mutual respect among the states of the region.

paragraphs.text: Our common achievement is consultative summits of the Central Asian Heads of State, which was put forth as an initiative at the 72nd session of the United Nations General Assembly and has been regularly held since then.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Our common achievement is consultative summits of the Central Asian Heads 
of State, which was put forth as an initiative at the 72nd session of the United Nations 
General Assembly and has been regularly held since then.

paragraphs.text: Over the past four years, Uzbekistan’s bilateral trade with neighbouring states has grown almost five-fold.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Over the past four years, Uzbekistan’s bilateral trade with neighbouring states 
has grown almost five-fold.

paragraphs.text: During these days of trial our countries are standing by and not leaving one another alone.
paragraphs.raw_text:
During these days of trial our countries are standing by and not leaving one 
another alone.

paragraphs.text: Today, the Central Asian states face an important strategic task.
paragraphs.raw_text: Today, the Central Asian states face an important strategic task.

paragraphs.text: This is to ensure deep integration of our region into the global economic, transport and transit corridors.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This is to ensure deep integration of our region into the global economic, 
transport and transit corridors.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, we propose to establish a Regional Centre for the Development of Transport and Communications under the auspices of the United Nations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, we propose to establish a Regional Centre for the Development 
of Transport and Communications under the auspices of the United Nations.

paragraphs.text: Today, the effective security cooperation is maintained in Central Asia.
paragraphs.raw_text: Today, the effective security cooperation is maintained in Central Asia.

paragraphs.text: The United Nations Global Anti-Terrorism Strategy is being successfully implemented.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The 
United 
Nations 
Global 
Anti-Terrorism 
Strategy 
is 
being 
successfully implemented.

paragraphs.text: We are in favour of conducting the International conference on the ten-year results and forthcoming prospects of this Joint Plan of the Regional Strategy.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are in favour of conducting the International conference on the ten-year 
results and forthcoming prospects of this Joint Plan of the Regional Strategy.

paragraphs.text: As it is well-known, the ancient cultural and rich spiritual heritage of our region is of global importance.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As it is well-known, the ancient cultural and rich spiritual heritage of our 
region is of global importance.

paragraphs.text: We are ready to hold the International Forum “Central Asia at the Crossroads of World Civilizations” in the ancient city of Khiva in 2021 in cooperation with UNESCO.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are ready to hold the International Forum “Central Asia at the Crossroads 
of World Civilizations” in the ancient city of Khiva in 2021 in cooperation 
with UNESCO.

paragraphs.text: DEAR PARTICIPANTS OF THE SESSION!
paragraphs.raw_text: DEAR PARTICIPANTS OF THE SESSION!

paragraphs.text: We see Afghanistan as an integral part of Central Asia.
paragraphs.raw_text: We see Afghanistan as an integral part of Central Asia.

paragraphs.text: The Tashkent High-Level Conference on Afghanistan in March 2018 marked a new stage in the mobilization of the international community’s efforts to resolve the Afghan problem.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Tashkent High-Level Conference on Afghanistan in March 2018 marked a 
new stage in the mobilization of the international community’s efforts to resolve the 
Afghan problem.

paragraphs.text: We fully support the peace talks among the Afghan political forces launched this year in the city of Doha in September.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We fully support the peace talks among the Afghan political forces launched 
this year in the city of Doha in September.

paragraphs.text: We express hope that these talks will serve for bringing in peace and stability in the long-suffering land of Afghanistan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We express hope that these talks will serve for bringing in peace and stability 
in the long-suffering land of Afghanistan.

paragraphs.text: In order to broadly involve Afghanistan in the process of economic integration in the region, we have started the implementation of major infrastructure projects such as the Surkhan-Puli Khumri power line and construction of a railway from Mazar-i-Sharif to the sea ports of the Indian Ocean.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In order to broadly involve Afghanistan in the process of economic integration 
in the region, we have started the implementation of major infrastructure projects 
such as the Surkhan-Puli Khumri power line and construction of a railway from 
Mazar-i-Sharif to the sea ports of the Indian Ocean.

paragraphs.text: We believe that the issues of ensuring peace and stability in Afghanistan must remain a constant focus of the United Nations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We believe that the issues of ensuring peace and stability in Afghanistan must 
remain a constant focus of the United Nations.

paragraphs.text: Only together and through close cooperation we can realize all the dreams and aspirations of the Afghan people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Only together and through close cooperation we can realize all the dreams and 
aspirations of the Afghan people.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, it is important to work on the principle of “From instability and destruction — to peace and prosperity”.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, it is important to work on the principle of “From instability and 
destruction — to peace and prosperity”.

paragraphs.text: To this end, we propose to establish a permanent UN commission on Afghanistan that would address the concerns of long-suffering Afghan people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To this end, we propose to establish a permanent UN commission on 
Afghanistan that would address the concerns of long-suffering Afghan people.

paragraphs.text: The main task of this Commission must be to promote and facilitate the economic and social development of Afghanistan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The main task of this Commission must be to promote and facilitate the 
economic and social development of Afghanistan.

paragraphs.text: DISTINGUISHED HEADS OF STATE AND GOVERNMENT! Another acute problem of our time is related to global climate change. Today, every country feels the negative effects of this process.
paragraphs.raw_text:
DISTINGUISHED HEADS OF STATE AND GOVERNMENT! Another 
acute problem of our time is related to global climate change. Today, every country 
feels the negative effects of this process.

paragraphs.text: Unfortunately, such negative developments also pose a great threat to the sustainable development of Central Asia.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Unfortunately, such negative developments also pose a great threat to the 
sustainable development of Central Asia.

paragraphs.text: I would like to once again draw your attention to the devastating effects of the drying up of the Aral Sea.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to once again draw your attention to the devastating effects of the 
drying up of the Aral Sea.

paragraphs.text: The Aral Sea region became the centre of an environmental tragedy.
paragraphs.raw_text: The Aral Sea region became the centre of an environmental tragedy.

paragraphs.text: To mitigate the current situation, we are carrying out an enormous work to create two million hectares of new plantations and forests, to form a layer of soil.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To mitigate the current situation, we are carrying out an enormous work to 
create two million hectares of new plantations and forests, to form a layer of soil.

paragraphs.text: On our country’s initiative, the United Nations Multi-Partner Human Security Trust Fund for the Aral Sea Region was established.
paragraphs.raw_text:
On our country’s initiative, the United Nations Multi-Partner Human Security 
Trust Fund for the Aral Sea Region was established.

paragraphs.text: We hope that this Fund will serve as a base platform for the international community to provide practical assistance to the population living in a stressed ecological zone.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We hope that this Fund will serve as a base platform for the international 
community to provide practical assistance to the population living in a stressed 
ecological zone.

paragraphs.text: We propose to adopt a special resolution of the UN General Assembly declaring the Aral Sea region an area of ecological innovation and technologies.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We propose to adopt a special resolution of the UN General Assembly declaring 
the Aral Sea region an area of ecological innovation and technologies.

paragraphs.text: It would be expedient to mark the date of adoption of this important document as the International Day for the Protection and Restoration of Ecosystems.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It would be expedient to mark the date of adoption of this important document 
as the International Day for the Protection and Restoration of Ecosystems.

paragraphs.text: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!
paragraphs.raw_text: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!

paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I would like to emphasize yet another point: the continuing unrest in various parts of the world, the growing conflict and violence, environmental disasters and other modern threats are exacerbating the global problems of misery and poverty.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In conclusion, I would like to emphasize yet another point: the continuing 
unrest in various parts of the world, the growing conflict and violence, environmental 
disasters and other modern threats are exacerbating the global problems of misery 
and poverty.

paragraphs.text: These problems become especially acute in the condition of pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text: These problems become especially acute in the condition of pandemic.

paragraphs.text: The voice of poverty, which is getting even more alarming today, must raise concerns in entire world community and all of us.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The voice of poverty, which is getting even more alarming today, must raise 
concerns in entire world community and all of us.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, we propose to set the issues of poverty eradication and the fight against poverty as one of the main topics of the next session of the United Nations General Assembly and hold a Global Summit on these issues.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, we propose to set the issues of poverty eradication and the fight 
against poverty as one of the main topics of the next session of the United Nations 
General Assembly and hold a Global Summit on these issues.

paragraphs.text: DEAR FRIENDS!
paragraphs.raw_text: DEAR FRIENDS!

paragraphs.text: It is clear to all of us that the socio-economic landscape of the post-pandemic world will be completely different.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is clear to all of us that the socio-economic landscape of the post-pandemic 
world will be completely different.

paragraphs.text: We need to work on the basis of new approaches and close cooperation against common threats to security and sustainable development.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We need to work on the basis of new approaches and close cooperation against 
common threats to security and sustainable development.

paragraphs.text: The central role of the United Nations as a coordinating international structure needs to be further strengthened.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The central role of the United Nations as a coordinating international structure 
needs to be further strengthened.

paragraphs.text: Uzbekistan always stands ready to develop a wide-ranging and mutually beneficial partnership with all countries of the world, as well as practical dialogue with the United Nations and its institutions.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Uzbekistan always stands ready to develop a wide-ranging and mutually 
beneficial partnership with all countries of the world, as well as practical dialogue 
with the United Nations and its institutions.

paragraphs.text: Thank you for your attention.
paragraphs.raw_text: Thank you for your attention.
